t: 瑞典和俄罗斯之间的纳普埃战役在 Ostrobothnia 的 Isokyrö 进行。
te: The battle of Napue between Sweden and Russia is fought in Isokyrö, Ostrobothnia.
dz: 大北方战争：瑞典和俄罗斯之间的纳普埃战役在 Ostrobothnia 的 Isokyrö 进行。
de: Great Northern War: The battle of Napue between Sweden and Russia is fought in Isokyrö, Ostrobothnia.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫(Johann Sebastian Bach)在施洛斯·魏玛(Schlo…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata for Pentecost, Erschallet, ihr Lieder, BWV 172, at the…
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫(Johann Sebastian Bach)在施洛斯·魏玛(Schloss Weimar)的礼拜堂领衔主演了"五旬节"(Cantata for Pentecost, Erschallet,ihr Lieder, BWV 172)的首场演出.
de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata for Pentecost, Erschallet, ihr Lieder, BWV 172, at the chapel of Schloss Weimar.

t: 俄罗斯海军在汉科半岛附近的甘古特海战中与瑞典海军的第一次重大胜利。
te: The first significant victory of the Russian Navy in the naval battle of Gangut against the Swedish Navy near the Hanko…
dz: 大北方战争：俄罗斯海军在汉科半岛附近的甘古特海战中与瑞典海军的第一次重大胜利。
de: The Great Northern War: The first significant victory of the Russian Navy in the naval battle of Gangut against the Swedish Navy near the Hanko Peninsula.

t: 汉诺威选帝侯乔治出任大不列颠国王乔治一世,标志着格鲁吉亚时代英国历史的开始.
te: George, Elector of Hanover, becomes King George I of Great Britain, marking the beginning of the Georgian era of Britis…
dz: 汉诺威选帝侯乔治出任大不列颠国王乔治一世,标志着格鲁吉亚时代英国历史的开始.
de: George, Elector of Hanover, becomes King George I of Great Britain, marking the beginning of the Georgian era of British history.

t: 俄罗斯海军第一次重要胜利.
te: The first important victory of the Russian Navy.
dz: 甘古特战役:俄罗斯海军第一次重要胜利.
de: The Battle of Gangut: The first important victory of the Russian Navy.

t: 法国王国和神圣罗马帝国之间的巴登条约得到批准.
te: The treaty of Baden between the kingdom of France and the Holy Roman Empire is ratified.
dz: 法国王国和神圣罗马帝国之间的巴登条约得到批准.
de: The treaty of Baden between the kingdom of France and the Holy Roman Empire is ratified.

t: 加泰罗尼亚公国首都巴塞罗那,在加泰罗尼亚战争中向西班牙和法国波旁军队投降,是西班牙继承战争的最…
te: Barcelona, capital city of the Principality of Catalonia, surrenders to Spanish and French Bourbon armies in the War of…
dz: 围攻巴塞罗那:加泰罗尼亚公国首都巴塞罗那,在加泰罗尼亚战争中向西班牙和法国波旁军队投降,是西班牙继承战争的最后阶段.
de: Siege of Barcelona: Barcelona, capital city of the Principality of Catalonia, surrenders to Spanish and French Bourbon armies in the War of the Catalans, the last phase of the War of the Spanish Succession.

t: 俄罗斯沙皇国的哥萨克人,在"大怒"期间,在海洛乌多夜里杀死了大约800人.
te: The Cossacks of the Tsardom of Russia kill about 800 people overnight in Hailuoto during the Great Wrath.
dz: 俄罗斯沙皇国的哥萨克人,在"大怒"期间,在海洛乌多夜里杀死了大约800人.
de: The Cossacks of the Tsardom of Russia kill about 800 people overnight in Hailuoto during the Great Wrath.
